champion.builds: THE BEST K'SANTE BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR MID IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular K'Sante Mid build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, followed by Shield Bash, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, as well as Biscuit Delivery and Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Health Scaling in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Iceborn Gauntlet as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Unending Despair. For your last 3 items, you should build Jak'Sho, The Protean, Thornmail and finish with Randuin's Omen. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 48.3% winrate over 149 matches played. Optional Your second option for K'Sante Mid build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Aftershock as your keystone, Shield Bash, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Health Scaling in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Kaenic Rookern, which you should build first, followed by Mercury's Treads as your second item and Iceborn Gauntlet as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Jak'Sho, The Protean, Randuin's Omen and Unending Despair. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 42.3% win rate over 137 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, Shield Bash, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Health Scaling, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Kaenic Rookern as your first item, then Mercury's Treads as a second item and Iceborn Gauntlet as a third item. You want to finish the build with Jak'Sho, The Protean, Thornmail and Frozen Heart. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 48.5% win rate across 130 matches played. Situational K'Sante Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your K'Sante build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out K'Sante runes page.
